aboutMeText: I am a software engineer with more than 11 years of professional experience across China and Japan. My primary focus is backend and distributed systems, but I also have hands-on experience across the entire technology stack, including frontend development, databases, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
experienceText: From ZTE to IP Consulting, I've led architecture design and development of enterprise systems across China and Japan, with 6 key positions spanning 2015-2026.
skillsText: Backend: Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Spring Boot, Gin, Microservices. Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue.js. Cloud: AWS, GCP, Kubernetes. Databases: MySQL, Redis, Cassandra, MongoDB.
technicalLeadershipText: Throughout my career, I have taken technical leadership responsibilities in addition to individual development, focusing on architecture design, technology selection, and team mentoring.
developmentPhilosophyText: I approach engineering problems through a continuous Why → What → How → Why cycle.
dpWhyText: Why does the problem exist? Before implementing a solution, I first identify the root cause, the actual business or technical problem, and the constraints around it.
dpWhatText: What needs to be done to solve the problem? I evaluate possible approaches, trade-offs, and the impact of each decision before choosing what to build or change.
dpHowText: How should it be implemented, and how can we ensure it works? I consider architecture, implementation details, testing, observability, and operational requirements.
dpWhyAgainText: Why did the system behave differently from what we expected? After implementation, I verify the result against the original problem and continuously investigate unexpected behavior.
dpIterationText: Unexpected behavior is not simply a failure — it is new information. I use it to revisit the Why, redefine the What, improve the How, and continue the cycle.
dpSummary: This approach helps me avoid solving symptoms instead of root causes, while balancing technical quality, business requirements, and long-term system health.
aiAssistedDevelopmentText: I actively use modern AI-assisted development techniques throughout the development process: Requirement → Task Decomposition → Context Preparation → Architecture/Design → Implementation → Review → Testing → Optimization.
